mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE) and high consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust economic growth and rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% and RSAFS is above 700,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate (falling > 0.2pp over 3 months) signals improving labor market conditions and rising corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE falling > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% and falling > 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 105.0 (2017=100) signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand for residential construction and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises above 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 325.0) signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 325.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong household demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
